sequence.root_cause: GCC follows the inactive final-promise union alternative when destroying the fresh Seq temporary moved into LogPollBatch in ServerCall::CommitBatch. SeqState initializes its state to kState0 and constructs only that state; its destructor dispatches on the same state. The reported Status and Waker belong to WaitForCqEndOp in the final alternative, constructed only after preceding polls complete. Its own variant distinguishes NotStarted (Status), Started (Waker) and Invalid. Each successful transition constructs the new member before storing the new discriminator. The reported construction/move path has never been polled.
sequence.reproduction: Recompiling the exact server_call.cc with OBS GCC 13 flags emits all three exact sites. The reduced sequence control does not emit them.
sequence.control: 60000 checks cover early destruction in all three sequence states, ready completion, pre-poll moves through LogPollBatch, real WaitForCqEndOp inactive storage, allocated Status moves and exact Wakeable ownership/drop/wake counts. No move after polling is attempted, as upstream prohibits it.
sequence.valgrind: Zero errors, zero definite/indirect/possible losses, zero suppressions; 53456 reachable bytes are the linked core global statistics storage.

upb.site: bits/string_fortified.h:29, inlined from _upb_MiniTableField_DataCopy through _upb_Message_SetTaggedMessagePtr and upb_Message_DeepClone
upb.root_cause: The pointer setter constrains field representation to pointer width (8 bytes here) using UPB_ASSUME, with a scalar message field. GCC 13 LTO nevertheless diagnoses the unreachable StringView arm of the generic field-copy switch, which would copy 16 bytes from the 8-byte tagged message pointer. The 16-byte arm remains valid for actual StringView fields.
upb.reproduction: The standalone control plus the unmodified copy.c, compiled with the exact OBS C flags and GCC 13 LTO, reproduces the exact 16-from-8 warning at link time.
upb.control: 100000 deep clones cover empty, null enum, double, string, bool, nested message, map, repeated and recursive oneof values. Each source arena is freed before the clone is serialized and compared byte-for-byte. Two malformed nested wire inputs are rejected.
upb.valgrind: Zero errors, zero definite/indirect/possible losses, zero suppressions.
